# Ramune

> Foundation for building Workers-style platforms in Go; Cloudflare-Workers-compatible out of the box. Author handlers as Workers-style ES modules (`export default { fetch(req, env, ctx), scheduled }`), serve them with the `ramune serve` CLI or the `workers.Register` Go API, and **design your own `env`** (Redis, Postgres, S3, SMTP, your own gRPC service, anything) by registering a callback and a tiny JS facade. Code written against Cloudflare Workers runs unchanged because the default surface is CF-compatible. `ramune compile --hybrid` performs soundness-gated AOT native compilation: functions whose signature and body are statically provable to be semantics-equivalent to Go are extracted into native Go at compile time; the rest stay on the JS floor. Also a complete JS/TS runtime (run/test/check/fmt/lint/repl/compile) and embeddable JS engine. Tri-backend: JavaScriptCore (JIT, macOS/Linux) via [purego](https://github.com/ebitengine/purego), qjswasm (pure Go, cross-platform incl. Windows — QuickJS-NG compiled to WebAssembly and driven by wazero) via [fastschema/qjs](https://github.com/fastschema/qjs), and goja (pure Go, reflect-based) via [dop251/goja](https://github.com/dop251/goja) — no Cgo required for any of them.

## Backends

Three backends, same API:
- **JSC** (default): Apple JavaScriptCore via purego. JIT, macOS/Linux.
- **qjswasm** (`-tags qjswasm`): QuickJS-NG compiled to WebAssembly, driven by wazero's compiler-mode JIT (AOT WASM→native). Pure Go, macOS/Linux/Windows/FreeBSD. Beats the previous modernc.org/quickjs backend (removed 2026-04) by 1.7-2.3× on req/s and scales 5.72× to 6 workers.
- **goja** (`-tags goja`): dop251/goja, pure Go, reflect-based. Smallest footprint (no ~1 MB wasm embed). ~94% ECMAScript coverage, macOS/Linux/Windows/FreeBSD.

## Getting Started

- [README](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/README.md): Install, quick start, all CLI commands, embedding in Go, benchmarks
- [Go Package Documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/i2y/ramune): Full API reference

## CLI Runtime

- [CLI (cmd/ramune)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/cmd/ramune/main.go): `ramune run`, `ramune serve`, `ramune eval`, `ramune repl`, `ramune test`, `ramune build`, `ramune bench`, `ramune x`, `ramune init/add/remove/install`, `ramune setup-jit`, `ramune skills install`. Dispatches to the separate `ramune-toolchain` binary for `check` / `fmt` / `lint` / `compile` / `transpile` / `typegen` (keeps the main ramune binary free of the tsgo + rslint + gotranspiler init cost).
- [Toolchain CLI (cmd/ramune-toolchain)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/cmd/ramune-toolchain/main.go): `check` (tsgo type check), `fmt` (tsgo formatter), `lint` (rslint), `compile` (bundle handler + runtime into a single Go binary; the `--native` TS→Go path for extension modules is experimental, see below), `transpile` (TS→Go source, experimental), `typegen` (Go→.d.ts). Install alongside `ramune` via `go install github.com/i2y/ramune/cmd/ramune-toolchain@latest`.
- TypeScript/TSX support via typescript-go (TS 7) transpilation; same compiler backs `check`/`fmt`
- ESM (import/export) and CommonJS support — per-file emit via typescript-go, multi-file bundling via esbuild Build API
- `ramune compile` — compile JS/TS to standalone Go binary via go:embed
- `ramune compile --native <file.ts>` — transpile TypeScript to native Go extensions callable from JS via `require('native:name')` (experimental; inherits transpiler's status)
- `ramune transpile` — transpile TypeScript source files to Go source code
- `ramune typegen go:pkg... -o types.d.ts` — generate TypeScript .d.ts declarations from Go packages
- `ramune run --workers N` — multi-worker HTTP serving with parallel JSC VMs
- `ramune serve <entry.ts>` — Cloudflare-Workers-style ES-module handler (`export default { fetch(request, env, ctx), scheduled(event, env, ctx) }`). Reads optional `ramune.toml`, supports `--workers N` (round-robin across independent runtimes), `--sqlite <path>` (default `.ramune/data.db`) for env.DB / env.KV, `--sandbox` + `--allow-*`. Works with Hono directly.
- `ramune run --env-file` — .env file auto-loading (like Bun/Deno)
- `ramune run <script>` — package.json scripts runner
- package.json entry point, dependency resolution, and `exports` field support
- Watch mode (`-w` flag) via fsnotify
- Test runner with Jest/Bun-compatible API (describe, test, expect, jest.fn, jest.spyOn)
- Type checking via tsgo (`ramune check`, `ramune run --check`)
- Formatting via tsgo (`ramune fmt`)
- Linting via rslint (`ramune lint`)
- Deno-style permissions (`--sandbox`, `--allow-read`, `--allow-write`, `--allow-net`)
- Rich REPL with history, tab completion, colors (ergochat/readline + charmbracelet/lipgloss)

## TypeScript-to-Go Transpiler (Experimental)

- [Transpiler (internal/gotranspiler/)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/internal/gotranspiler/): Built-in TypeScript-to-Go transpiler (experimental — under active development)
- [Native Bridge (internal/gotranspiler/nativebridge.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/internal/gotranspiler/nativebridge.go): Discovers exported Go functions, generates NativeModuleFromFuncs bridge code
- Supported: number, string, boolean, arrays, Map, Set, Promise, generics, classes (static, abstract, getter/setter), interfaces, enums, discriminated unions, async/await, destructuring with defaults, template literals, array/string methods
- Operators: typeof, instanceof, in, delete, ?. (optional chaining), ?? (nullish coalescing), ** (exponentiation), >>>, &&=, ||=, ??=
- Loops: for, for...of, for...in, for await...of, while, labeled break/continue
- Modules: relative imports, Node.js built-in modules, npm packages (uuid, lodash, zod adapters), Go packages via `go:` prefix, export default, re-exports
- Type mapping: number→float64, string→string, boolean→bool, T[]→[]T, T|null→*T, Map<K,V>→map[K]V, Promise<T>→*promise.Promise[T], Class→struct+methods, conditional/mapped/intersection types resolved via checker
- Go interop: `go:` prefix imports any Go stdlib/third-party package, multi-return destructuring (`const [resp, err] = http.Get(url)`), auto go.mod for third-party modules
- Type generation: `ramune typegen go:fmt go:net/http` generates .d.ts with full function signatures, interfaces, and type mappings
- Limitations: no decorators, no generators/yield, no Symbol/Proxy, all numbers float64

## Core Library API

- [Runtime (engine_jsc.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/engine_jsc.go): New(), Close(), Eval(), Exec(), EvalAsync(), NewObject(), NewArray(), NewUint8Array(), RegisterFunc(), GlobalObject(), dispatch(), Wake()
- [Value (value_jsc.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/value_jsc.go): String(), Float64(), Bool(), Bytes(), Attr(), SetAttr(), Call(), Keys(), Len(), Index(), Has(), Delete(), ToMap(), ToSlice(), IsArray(), IsFunction(), Close()
- [JSFunc (jsfunc_jsc.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/jsfunc_jsc.go): Wraps JS function references passed to GoFunc callbacks; Call(args...) invokes the function, Close() releases the reference
- [Typed Registration (register.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/register.go): Register[F]() — generics-based typed Go function registration (supports *JSFunc parameters)
- [Struct Binding (bind.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/bind.go): Bind() — expose Go structs as JS objects with getters/setters/methods
- [Plugin System (module.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/module.go): Module, WithModule(), LoadModule(), NativeModuleFromFuncs() — custom require() modules and reflection-based native module creation
- [Native Instance (native_instance.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/native_instance.go): Per-type callback registry for struct→JS conversion with live getter/setter properties and methods
- [Type Conversion (convert_jsc.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/convert_jsc.go): Go↔JS conversion for bool, numbers, strings, nil, map[string]any, []any, []byte (Uint8Array), structs (live binding), *promise.Promise[T] (→JS Promise), *JSFunc (→JS function)
- [Error Handling (errors.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/errors.go): JSError with Message and Stack trace, ErrAlreadyClosed, ErrNilValue
- [GC Config (types.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/types.go): WithGC(GCConfig) — GCInterval, GCPercent for JSC GC tuning
- [Permissions (permissions.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/permissions.go): WithPermissions() — read/write/net/env/run access control
- [RuntimePool (pool.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/pool.go): NewPool(n) for multi-core parallel JS execution with HTTP dispatch
- [Workers Subpackage (workers/)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/tree/main/workers): `workers.Register(rt, file, src, opts...)` returns an `http.Handler` for Cloudflare-Workers-style ES-module handlers. `workers.Prepare` + `workers.AttachPrepared` share one typescript-go transpile across N runtimes. `ctx.waitUntil(promise)` holds the executor post-response up to `WithWaitUntilTimeout`. `WithSQLite(path)` installs a D1-style subset env.DB (`prepare`/`bind`/`all`/`first`/`run`/`exec`; no `batch`/`raw`) and a Workers-KV-like env.KV; `WithKVBackend` / `WithDBBackend` accept user-supplied `KVBackend` / `DBBackend` implementations (Redis, Postgres, in-memory...). `workers.d.ts` declares `Env`, `WorkersHandler`, `ExecutionContext`, `D1Database`, `KVNamespace`. `LoadRamuneTOML` / `ApplyRamuneTOML` parse the declarative `[dependencies]` / `[permissions]` / `[[kv_namespaces]]` schema.
- [Custom env Bindings (workers/BINDINGS.md)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/workers/BINDINGS.md): Pattern for adding any `env.FOO` — `env.QUEUE` (NATS / Kafka / Redis Streams), `env.R2` (S3 / minio), `env.EMAIL` (SMTP / SendGrid), `env.AI` (OpenAI / Anthropic), `env.DURABLE` (per-key singleton actors) — in a few lines of Go. Three pieces: (1) `rt.RegisterFunc("__env_foo_op", ...)` Go callback, (2) `WithExtraEnvJS` JS facade that assigns `env.FOO`, (3) optional TypeScript `interface Env { FOO: ... }` augmentation. The IIFE composition pattern on `globalThis.__extraEnvBindings` lets multiple packages stack bindings without collisions. Runnable example: [`examples/workers/custom-binding/`](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/tree/main/examples/workers/custom-binding).

## Event Loop & Async

- [Event Loop (eventloop.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/eventloop.go): Tick(), RunEventLoop(), RunEventLoopFor(), EvalAsync(), Wake() — channel-driven, zero-latency event delivery
- [Fetch (fetch.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/fetch.go): globalThis.fetch backed by Go net/http
- [Async Spawn (asyncspawn.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/asyncspawn.go): child_process.spawn with goroutine-backed I/O, channel-driven event delivery
- [Async FS (asyncfs.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/asyncfs.go): Real async fs.readFile/writeFile/stat/readdir via goroutines
- [Async Net (asyncnet.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/asyncnet.go): TCP/TLS client sockets via goroutines, channel-driven delivery
- [FS Watch (fswatch.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/fswatch.go): fs.watch() via fsnotify, integrated with event loop
- [Worker Threads (worker.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/worker.go): worker_threads with independent JSC contexts

## Web Platform APIs

- [Web Streams (webstreams.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/webstreams.go): ReadableStream, WritableStream, TransformStream with pipeTo/pipeThrough/tee/async iterator
- [Web Crypto (webcrypto.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/webcrypto.go): crypto.subtle — digest, sign/verify, encrypt/decrypt, importKey/exportKey, deriveBits/deriveKey, getRandomValues, randomUUID
- Blob, File, FormData, Headers, Request, Response (with ReadableStream body)
- performance.now/mark/measure, structuredClone, AbortController, TextEncoder/TextDecoder, URL/URLSearchParams, navigator, WebSocket (server-side)

## Ramune APIs & Bun Compatibility

- [Ramune/Bun APIs (buncompat.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/buncompat.go): Ramune.serve() (HTTP server), Ramune.file(), Ramune.write(), Ramune.password, Ramune.sleep(), Ramune.hash(), Ramune.plugin() (onLoad filters, virtual modules), Request/Response with ReadableStream body. Bun.* available as alias. Works with Hono.
- [WebSocket (websocket.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/websocket.go): WebSocket server for Ramune.serve()
- [SQLite (sqlite.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/sqlite.go): bun:sqlite — pure Go SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite

## Node.js Compatibility

- [NodeCompat (nodecompat.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/nodecompat.go): fs (90%, async + sync + watch), path (100%), crypto (85% + crypto.subtle), child_process (80%), stream (85%, class extends, asyncIterator, backpressure, cork/uncork), zlib (75%, gzip/deflate/brotli), os (85%), events (85%), http/https (80%), http2 (75%, trailers, multiplexing), net/tls (70%, incl. net.createServer), Buffer (90%), url (80%), assert (80%), util (80%, types/promisify/format/debuglog), readline (70%), dns (basic), worker_threads (80%, SharedArrayBuffer, Atomics.waitAsync), vm (70%), querystring (80%), timers/promises (70%), perf_hooks (basic), process (85%, signals/exit/env/tty), tty (70%, isatty/WriteStream), dgram (70%, UDP), async_hooks (basic AsyncLocalStorage), module (createRequire, file-based require with ESM-to-CJS)
- [npm Bundling (bundle.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/bundle.go): Dependencies() fetches from npm registry and bundles via esbuild (no npm/bun CLI required). Subpath imports supported (e.g., "react-dom/server"). PreloadJS() injects polyfills before bundles
- [Package Registry (internal/registry/)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/internal/registry/): npm registry client, semver resolution, lockfile (ramune.lock)
- [VM Module (vm_jsc.go)](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/vm_jsc.go): vm.createContext, runInContext, runInNewContext, Script — isolated JSC contexts

## Benchmarks

### JSC backend (default)

| Test | Ramune | Bun | Node.js |
|------|--------|-----|---------|
| Hello World | 17.7 ms | 7.7 ms | 19.6 ms |
| Fibonacci(35) | 53.5 ms | 44.6 ms | 71.6 ms |
| JSON 10K | 20.5 ms | 10.0 ms | 24.6 ms |
| HTTP req/s (single) | 90.5 K | 111 K | 89.8 K |

### qjswasm backend (`-tags qjswasm`)

Multi-Runtime Pool scaling (JSON handler, Apple M4 Max, wrk):

| Workers | req/s | Scaling |
|---------|-------|---------|
| 1 | 2,348 | 1.0x |
| 2 | 4,666 | 1.99x |
| 3 | 6,782 | 2.89x |
| 4 | 9,152 | 3.90x |
| 6 | 13,435 | 5.72x |

Monotonic out to 6 workers and still linear. QuickJS-NG on wazero sidesteps the global-allocator contention that required a forked libc for the previous modernc backend.

### goja backend (`-tags goja`)

Multi-Runtime Pool scaling (JSON handler, Apple M4 Max, wrk):

| Workers | req/s | Scaling |
|---------|-------|---------|
| 1 | 3,518 | 1.0x |
| 2 | 5,833 | 1.66x |
| 3 | 7,404 | 2.10x |
| 4 | 8,374 | 2.38x |
| 6 | 10,173 | 2.89x |

Faster than qjswasm at 1-3 workers (lower setup cost); qjswasm pulls ahead at 4+ workers.

Multi-runtime pool (JSC): 1 worker 40K → 3 workers 58K req/s (JSON handler).

vs Go runtimes (fib(35)): Ramune (JSC+JIT) 35ms vs Ramune (qjswasm) 1,987ms vs Ramune (goja) 2,400ms vs otto 26,413ms.

Run `make bench` to reproduce.

## Agent Skills

Ramune ships with an embedded [Agent Skill](https://agentskills.io/) that teaches AI agents how to use Ramune. Install via `ramune skills install` (writes to both `~/.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`).

- [ramune](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/cmd/ramune/skills/ramune/SKILL.md): Use Ramune — CLI commands, Go library API, HTTP server, multi-core pool, Node.js compatibility

## Platform Support

- macOS: JavaScriptCore built-in, JIT via `ramune setup-jit`
- Linux: libjavascriptcoregtk (4.0/4.1/6.0)
- Windows / FreeBSD: qjswasm backend (`-tags qjswasm`) or goja backend (`-tags goja`), no system deps
- [CI](https://github.com/i2y/ramune/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): macOS + Ubuntu 22.04/24.04
